div.head: II Cn 28
div.ab: And þæt nan man nænne man ne underfo na længc þonne þreo niht, butan hine se befæste, þe he ær folgade.
And þæt nan man nenne man ne underfo na leng þonne þreo niht, buton he hine befeaste se, ðe he ær folgade.
Et nemo suscipiat aliquem ultra trinoctium, nisi ipse commendet, cui antea seruiuit.
⁊ þæt nan man nænne man underfó na leng ðonne III niht, buton híne se befæste ðe he ær folgade.
And þæt nan man nænne man ne underfo na længc þonne þreo niht, butan hine se befæste, þe he ær folgade.
Und dass niemand einen Mann länger als drei Nächte aufnehme, wenn denselben nicht der empfiehlt, welchem derselbe bisher commendirt war.
And that no one receive any man for longer than three nights unless the one whom he previously served commends him.
And no-one shall entertain any man for more than three days, unless he is committed to his charge by the man whom he has been serving.
And no one is to entertain any man for more than three days, unless he whom he previously served commits him to him.
And no one shall detain a servant for more than three nights unless the latter has been entrusted to him by the person he previously followed.
